identity_mapping.fortification: Legendary tier + Fortification effect + Prefix removal + 100 Legendary-tier broken shackles match the retained Wiki Prefix recipe.
identity_mapping.spot: Legendary tier + Spot effect + Extra removal + 100 Legendary-tier broken collars match the retained Wiki Skills-except-UMD recipe; retained Spot membership completes the skill mapping.
identity_mapping.host: Retained Legendary Chains Prefix/Extra slots and the shared base-item crafting statement establish applicability.

independent_review.scope: Reviewed root's observed clauses and their correspondence to retained source premises; did not independently control the browser.
independent_review.conclusion: The missing Legendary classification premises are supplied. A bounded multi-source derivation is defensible. Remaining uncertainty is source accuracy/provenance, not an unsupported Heroic-to-Legendary type assumption.
independent_review.requirement: Retain exact variant, slot, ingredients, added markup, absent numeric parameters, and source limitations.

changes: Admit only the two captured Nexus recipe definitions through a bounded source contract; preserve their URLs and observations without inventing Wiki-style revisions.
Qualify the two selected Chains components through the retained Wiki values and host mapping.

Add only the two reviewed Spot interactions: Chains–Heroism and Chains–Luck, using the retained affirmative stacking premise.
proposed_integration.target_limits: Targets apply after approved implementation and unchanged full-kit level/completeness checks. They are selected-gear subtotals, not whole-character values or damage-reduction percentages.
